claim_text: No Human Data Budget experiment has been run or verified in this repository.
allowed_wording_now: State plainly as a fact about the repository.
consequence_if_missing_or_invalid: None. This claim is the honest default and must remain true until run artifacts exist.

claim_text: Recursive training on generated data can degrade model fit, diversity, or tail coverage in studied settings, while the outcome depends strongly on the data workflow and source distribution.
allowed_wording_now: "Prior work shows collapse in some recursive workflows and stability in others."
consequence_if_missing_or_invalid: Drop the sentence. Never generalise to "recursive training causes collapse" without the workflow qualifier.

claim_text: At equal lifetime human-token and total optimizer-token budgets, joint allocation reduces chain-level regret relative to the strongest schedule-only and selection-only baselines.
allowed_wording_now: "The project will test whether joint allocation improves human-rescue efficiency under a fixed lifetime budget."
consequence_if_missing_or_invalid: Result-bearing sentences stay RESULT_PENDING. If the powered interval includes the practically equivalent or harmful region, use the null template in paper/outcome_contingent_language.md.

claim_text: The advantage of targeted allocation decreases or reverses when the monitoring reference omits globally important modes.
allowed_wording_now: "The monitoring-omission experiment is designed to test a failure boundary."
consequence_if_missing_or_invalid: Report as designed-but-not-run. Do not describe the boundary as observed.

claim_text: The joint problem of allocating one fixed lifetime stock of human-origin optimizer tokens across recursive generations and monitored human-distribution modes is distinguishable from the closest audited work.
allowed_wording_now: "The audited literature leaves a narrower, provisional distinction" followed by the modifiers recursive, fixed lifetime human-token budget, and matched non-joint baselines.
consequence_if_missing_or_invalid: Withdraw or rewrite under the C-004 novelty stop rule. Threats 3 and 4 are the strongest; if either defeats the claim, narrow it before implementation.

claim_text: Under-covered modes with high projected future regret may have greater marginal value for human anchors.
allowed_wording_now: Present strictly as a proposed mechanism, never as an explanation of an observed effect.
consequence_if_missing_or_invalid: Delete any sentence that uses the mechanism to explain a result.

claim_text: Compared policies consume identical lifetime human-origin and total optimizer tokens.
evidence_status: Enforced in code; not yet demonstrated on a real run
allowed_wording_now: "Budget-matched schedule-only, selection-only, and joint policies are planned."
consequence_if_missing_or_invalid: If a real run fails the equality preflight the comparison is not budget-matched and every derived contrast is invalid.

claim_text: Held-out human NLL and tail retention are computed on a partition never used for selection.
evidence_status: Enforced in code; not yet demonstrated on a real run
allowed_wording_now: Describe the partition rule as designed and unit-tested.
consequence_if_missing_or_invalid: Any leakage invalidates every downstream result; the validator returns invalid with SEPARATION_OVERLAP.

claim_text: The experimental unit is one independently seeded recursive chain.
allowed_wording_now: State the unit explicitly wherever an interval is reported.
consequence_if_missing_or_invalid: Any interval whose width implies generation-level n is wrong and must be recomputed across chains.

claim_text: Every paper-facing number is generated from an immutable aggregate, never typed.
allowed_wording_now: Describe the generation path from chain results to table.
consequence_if_missing_or_invalid: A hand-entered value is a protocol violation. Remove it and regenerate from the aggregate.
